resources.string: This resolves the conflicting fields using the selected version, including a conflicting deletion. The result will be shared on the next sync. Review your choice before continuing.
Historical values cannot be previewed here. Check the item on the source devices before choosing.
Local: this device at the time of the conflict.\nIncoming: the received version, which may not be the latest.
Automatic snapshots may be pruned. Manual snapshots stay until you delete them.
